name: Epic Robe of Dissonance
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Robe of Dissonance

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Spell Resonance
effects.tooltip: Spell Resonance : This item hums ominously with suppressed energy. When casting Force spells, there is a chance that you will gain a +20 alchemical bonus to Force Spell Power for 30 seconds. When casting Sonic spells, there is a chance that you will gain a +20 alchemical bonus to Sonic Spell Power 30 seconds.

effects.name: Soundproof
effects.tooltip: Soundproof : Protects against stunning , dazing and disorientation from sound-based spells such as Soundburst and Greater Shout .

effects.name: Resonance
effects.tooltip: Resonance +111 : Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power .

effects.name: Impulse
effects.tooltip: Impulse +111 : Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power .

effects.name: Sonic Resistance
effects.tooltip: Sonic Resistance +36 : Passive: +36 Enhancement bonus to your Sonic Resistance.

flavor_text: This vibrant robe hums faintly with two separate yet intertwined forces. The magical field it projects blocks harmful sound-based effects, as well as strengthening the wearer's sonic-based and force-based spells.

source.raw: Epic version of Robe of Dissonance
